name: flaggems_scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention_backward
description: Backward pass of the cuDNN scaled dot product attention (aten._scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention_backward). Inputs are produced by a consistent cuDNN forward pass over uniform-initialized Q/K/V (bhsd layout), matching tests/test_flash_attention_backward.py::test_scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention_backward. Returns grad_query, grad_key, grad_value in bhsd layout.
reference:
import torch


def run(dOut, Q, K, V, out, lse, philox_seed, philox_offset, attn_bias, cum_seq_q, cum_seq_k, max_q, max_k, dropout_p, is_causal, scale):
    dQ, dK, dV = torch.ops.aten._scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention_backward(
        dOut, Q, K, V, out, lse,
        philox_seed, philox_offset, attn_bias,
        cum_seq_q, cum_seq_k, max_q, max_k, dropout_p, is_causal,
        scale=scale,
    )
    return dQ, dK, dV


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    import torch
    from flag_gems.runtime import torch_device_fn
    from flag_gems.utils.random_utils import set_philox_state

    q_shape = ctx["Q__shape"]
    k_shape = ctx["K__shape"]
    batch, num_head, q_seq_len, head_size = q_shape
    kv_seq_len = k_shape[2]
    dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["Q__dtype"])
    is_causal = ctx["is_causal"]
    scale = ctx["scale"]

    dev = torch_device_fn.current_device()
    set_philox_state(1234567890, 0, dev)
    Q = torch.empty(batch, q_seq_len, num_head, head_size, dtype=dtype, device=device).uniform_(-0.05, 0.05)
    K = torch.empty(batch, kv_seq_len, num_head, head_size, dtype=dtype, device=device).uniform_(-0.05, 0.05)
    V = torch.empty(batch, kv_seq_len, num_head, head_size, dtype=dtype, device=device).uniform_(-0.05, 0.05)
    dOut = torch.randn(batch, q_seq_len, num_head, head_size, dtype=dtype, device=device)

    attn_bias = None
    if "attn_bias__shape" in ctx:
        attn_bias = torch.randn(batch, num_head, q_seq_len, kv_seq_len, dtype=dtype, device=device) * 0.1

    Qf = Q.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()
    Kf = K.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()
    Vf = V.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()
    results = torch.ops.aten._scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention(
        Qf, Kf, Vf, attn_bias, compute_log_sumexp=True, dropout_p=0.0,
        is_causal=is_causal, return_debug_mask=False, scale=scale,
    )
    out_bhsd_fwd = results[0]
    lse_4d = results[1]
    philox_seed = results[2]
    philox_offset = results[3]
    out = out_bhsd_fwd.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()
    lse = lse_4d.squeeze(-1).float()

    Q_bhsd = Q.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()
    K_bhsd = K.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()
    V_bhsd = V.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()
    out_bhsd = out.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()
    dOut_bhsd = dOut.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()

    res = {
        "dOut": dOut_bhsd,
        "Q": Q_bhsd,
        "K": K_bhsd,
        "V": V_bhsd,
        "out": out_bhsd,
        "lse": lse,
        "philox_seed": philox_seed,
        "philox_offset": philox_offset,
    }
    if attn_bias is not None:
        res["attn_bias"] = attn_bias
    return res


def valid(ref_outputs, sol_outputs, inputs, ctx):
    import torch
    RES = {torch.float16: 1e-3, torch.bfloat16: 0.016, torch.float32: 1.3e-6, torch.float64: 1e-7}
    for ref_t, sol_t in zip(ref_outputs, sol_outputs):
        ref = ref_t.detach().to("cpu").to(torch.float64)
        sol = sol_t.detach().to("cpu").to(torch.float64)
        if ref.shape != sol.shape:
            return {"passed": False, "message": "shape mismatch", "metrics": {}}
        rtol = RES.get(sol_t.dtype, 1e-3)
        atol = 1e-4
        both_nan = torch.isnan(ref) & torch.isnan(sol)
        both_posinf = torch.isposinf(ref) & torch.isposinf(sol)
        both_neginf = torch.isneginf(ref) & torch.isneginf(sol)
        finite = torch.isfinite(ref) & torch.isfinite(sol)
        close = torch.zeros_like(ref, dtype=torch.bool)
        close[finite] = (ref[finite] - sol[finite]).abs() <= atol + rtol * ref[finite].abs()
        ok = (close | both_nan | both_posinf | both_neginf).all().item()
        if not ok:
            return {"passed": False, "message": "value mismatch", "metrics": {}}
    return {"passed": True, "message": "", "metrics": {}}
